description: This file contains Google Test unit tests demonstrating test fixtures, including setup and teardown logic, for functions like Factorial and IsPrime, as well as queue operations. It also includes class definitions for test fixtures such as QuickTest, IntegerFunctionTest, and QueueTest.

classes.name: QuickTest
classes.description: A test fixture class that measures test execution time and ensures tests complete within 5 seconds.

classes.name: IntegerFunctionTest
classes.description: A derived test fixture from QuickTest for testing integer functions like Factorial and IsPrime.

classes.name: QueueTest
classes.description: A derived test fixture from QuickTest that sets up queue objects for testing queue operations.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes start_time_ before each test in QuickTest and QueueTest fixtures.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Checks if the test took longer than 5 seconds in QuickTest.

methods.name: Factorial
methods.description: Function to compute factorial of an integer (used in tests).

methods.name: IsPrime
methods.description: Function to check if an integer is prime (used in tests).
